title: EEF CNA OSV record database_specific
description: The top-level database_specific object of an EEF CNA OSV record. The OSV schema (https://ossf.github.io/osv-schema/) defines the field and leaves its contents to the database.

$schema.description: URL of the schema version that the object conforms to.

cwe_ids.description: CWE IDs from the problemTypes of the CVE record.

capec_ids.description: CAPEC IDs from the impacts of the CVE record.

cpe_ids.description: CPE 2.3 names from all affected entries of the CVE record.
